newsitem.title: USA: Lehman shares rise as merger rumor resurfaces.
newsitem.headline: Lehman shares rise as merger rumor resurfaces.

text.p: Shares in Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. jumped Wednesday as rumours that the company was about to be acquired swirled through trading floors in New York and Chicago.
The company's stock added $6.25 to $40.375 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was one of the most active issues.
Lehman, which has been mentioned repeatedly recently as a possible acquisition target, declined to comment as a matter of company policy.
The NYSE said it asked Lehman for a public statement regarding the unusual market activity in its stock but the company declined to comment.
Traders said the current wave of talk about Lehman centred around J.P. Morgan & Co Inc. and Chase Manhattan Corp. as potential buyers at prices ranging upward from $50 per share.
"I keep hearing J.P. Morgan at 50," said one trader.
J.P. Morgan was the more frequently cited potential buyer in New York, with Chase emerging as the favoured candidate in the Midwest.
Officials at J.P. Morgan and Chase declined to comment.
